identity.name: Valencia Reserve
identity.notes: Upscale 55+ active adult community of 1,060 single-family Mediterranean-style homes built by GL Homes between 2009 and 2014. Homes range 1,300–3,500 sq ft with 2–4 bedrooms, 2–4 bathrooms, and 2–3 car garages. Situated along a series of lakes, most homes have water views. Pet friendly (aggressive dog breeds prohibited); leasing permitted with HOA approval once per year for a minimum 7-month term.

fees.note: Covers cable, lawn care, 24-hour gate security, and recreational facilities. From real-ativity.com listing; hoa-agent.com shows no verified fee range, so verify with the association directly. No special assessment signals reported for this community. (ZIP 33426, Boynton Beach, FL 33426, Palm Beach County.)
Page states '$753 to $755 per month. Recent public fee examples.' Conflicts with the $607/month figure from real-ativity.com; verify current fee via estoppel/association budget.
